title: 3D Turf War
statementMd:
In a four-dimensional world, video games would take place on three-dimensional screens in the same way we humans play video games on two-dimensional screens. There are $k$ four-dimensional beings playing their favorite game on an $m \times n \times h$ grid. Each player has their own color.

The game has $r$ turns. Each turn results in some player coloring a rectangular prism subgrid with their color. If any of these cells had been previously colored, they are overwritten to have the new color.

Formally, a turn is defined by a player number $i$ and two triples $(x_1, y_1, z_1)$ and $(x_2, y_2, z_2)$, where $x_1 \le x_2$; $y_1 \le y_2$; and $z_1 \le z_2$. Player $i$ colors all $(x, y, z)$ such that $x_1 \le x \le x_2$; $y_1 \le y \le y_2$; and $z_1 \le z \le z_2$. Below is an example of a turn for $m = 4, n = 3, h = 2$. The player has colored the subgrid defined by corners $(0, 0, 0)$ and $(2, 1, 1)$.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6319a3caf45d62d37f14cb9d9762993193da9417.png)

Your task is to calculate, at the end of the game, how many cells in the grid were only ever colored by one player. Note that a cell might get colored by the same player multiple times across different turns.

## Input

Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases $t$ ($1 \le t \le 50$). The description of the test cases follows.

The first line of each test case consists of five integers, $m$, $n$, $h$, $k$ and $r$ ($1 \le mnh, k, r \le 4 \cdot 10^5$) — this represents a $k$-player game lasting $r$ turns played on an $m \times n \times h$ grid.

The next $r$ lines of each test case consist of seven integers each: $i, x_1, y_1, z_1, x_2, y_2, z_2$ ($0 \le i, x_1, y_1, z_1, x_2, y_2, z_2 \lt 4 \cdot 10^5$). The following conditions are guaranteed: $i \lt k$; $x_1 \le x_2 \lt m$; $y_1 \le y_2 \lt n$; and $z_1 \le z_2 \lt h$. This line represents a turn in which player number $i$ colors the entire subgrid defined by $(x_1, y_1, z_1)$ and $(x_2, y_2, z_2)$.

It is guaranteed that the sum of $mnh$ over all test cases is at most $4 \cdot 10^5$ and the sum of $r$ over all test cases is at most $4 \cdot 10^5$.

## Output

For each test case, output a single integer — the number of cells in the grid that were only ever colored by exactly one player.

## Note

In the first test case, there are two players and three turns. Here are the game states after each turn.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6319a3caf45d62d37f14cb9d9762993193da9417.png) ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/73856186fa604674535d229933dcebe6d6789208.png)

The changes to the state after the third move are not visible from the previous angle, so a rotated view is below.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5c5833356ca47eb723b1177cf1166f9227e52abf.png)

In total, 16 cells were colored over the course of the game. Of these, the five cells $\{(1, 0, 0), (1, 1, 0), (1, 2, 0), (1, 0, 1), (1, 1, 1)\}$ were colored by both players at some point. The other 11 were only touched by one player (10 by the first player and 1 by the second player).
statementZhMd:
在四维世界中，电子游戏会在三维屏幕上进行，就像我们人类在二维屏幕上玩电子游戏一样。有 k𝑘 个四维生物正在一个 m×n×h𝑚×𝑛×ℎ 的网格上玩他们最喜欢的游戏。每名玩家都有自己的颜色。

游戏共有 r𝑟 个回合。每个回合，一名玩家会用自己的颜色为一个长方体子网格涂色。如果其中某些格子之前已经被涂过色，它们的颜色就会被新颜色覆盖。

形式化地，一个回合由玩家编号 i𝑖 和两个三元组 (x1,y1,z1)(𝑥1,𝑦1,𝑧1) 与 (x2,y2,z2)(𝑥2,𝑦2,𝑧2) 定义，其中 x1≤x2𝑥1≤𝑥2；y1≤y2𝑦1≤𝑦2；z1≤z2𝑧1≤𝑧2。玩家 i𝑖 会为所有满足 x1≤x≤x2𝑥1≤𝑥≤𝑥2、y1≤y≤y2 且 z1≤z≤z2 的格子 (x,y,z)(𝑥,𝑦,𝑧) 涂色。下图展示了 m=4,n=3,h=2 时的一个回合。该玩家为以 (0,0,0) 和 (2,1,1) 为对角顶点的子网格涂了色。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6319a3caf45d62d37f14cb9d9762993193da9417.png)

你的任务是计算，游戏结束时，网格中有多少个格子在整个游戏过程中仅被一名玩家涂过色。注意，同一名玩家可能在不同回合中多次为同一个格子涂色。

## 输入格式

每个测试包含多组测试用例。第一行包含测试用例的数量 t (1≤t≤50)。接下来是各组测试用例的描述。

每组测试用例的第一行包含五个整数 m、n、h、k 和 r (1≤mnh,k,r≤4⋅105)，表示一场在 m×n×h 网格上进行、共有 k 名玩家参与、持续 r 个回合的游戏。

每组测试用例接下来的 r 行，每行包含七个整数：i,x1,y1,z1,x2,y2,z2 (0≤i,x1,y1,z1,x2,y2,z2<4⋅105)。保证满足以下条件：i<k；x1≤x2<m；y1≤y2<n；z1≤z2<h。这一行表示一个回合，其中编号为 i 的玩家为以 (x1,y1,z1) 和 (x2,y2,z2) 为对角顶点的整个子网格涂色。

保证所有测试用例的 mnh 之和不超过 4⋅105，且所有测试用例的 r 之和不超过 4⋅105。

## 输出格式

对于每组测试用例，输出一个整数，表示网格中在整个游戏过程中恰好只被一名玩家涂过色的格子数量。

## 说明

在第一组测试用例中，有两名玩家和三个回合。每个回合结束后的游戏状态如下。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6319a3caf45d62d37f14cb9d9762993193da9417.png) ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/73856186fa604674535d229933dcebe6d6789208.png)

从之前的视角无法看到第三个回合带来的状态变化，因此下图展示了旋转视角后的状态。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5c5833356ca47eb723b1177cf1166f9227e52abf.png)

在整个游戏过程中，共有 16 个格子被涂过色。其中，五个格子 {(1,0,0),(1,1,0),(1,2,0),(1,0,1),(1,1,1)} 都曾被两名玩家涂过色。其余 11 个格子仅被一名玩家涂过色（其中 10 个由第一名玩家涂色，1 个由第二名玩家涂色）。
